name: Poulan 581506801 Wild Thing Toy Chainsaw
description: Modeled after the real gas chainsaw, the Poulan Wild Thing Toy Chainsaw is a great gift for the future lumberjack in your life. This toy makes realistic chainsaw noises and the chain actually rotates. It comes with work gloves and a red hard hat becomes even when playing pretend you have to play safe. It runs on 3 AA batteries, which are included in the package. Now your little one doesn't have to feel left out while you do yard work! They can practice their landscaping and gardening work with their Poulan Wild Thing Toy Chainsaw.
